import api
from collections import Counter
ids=[];p=1
while True:
    r=api.searchEmployees(name="Miller",page=p)
    it=r['body']['items']
    if not it: break
    ids+=[i['id'] for i in it]
    if p>20: break
    p+=1
print(len(ids),len(set(ids)))
c=Counter()
for i in sorted(set(ids)):
    b=api.getEmployee(i)['body']
    c[b.get('status')]+=1
print(c)
print(b)

import api
for i in range(1,100):
    r=api.getEmployee(i)
    b=r['body']
    print(i,b.get('firstName'),b.get('lastName'),b.get('status'))
